text: Bitcoin's flat-to-negative performance alongside extreme fear (10/100) and declining sentiment over the past week signals deep uncertainty, while Ethereum's modest outperformance suggests some rotation toward altcoins despite the bearish mood. Bitcoin dominance holding above 57% with $74B in volume indicates participants are neither fleeing entirely nor capitulating—a cautious stance rather than panic selling. The divergence between BTC stalling and smaller caps gaining ground suggests traders are selectively opportunistic rather than uniformly bearish.
